review.images: Reviewed the official Palmiera 3 hero and six gallery assets. Four exterior JPEGs match the Palmiera 2 gallery byte for byte. Kept the distinct wide crop published on the Palmiera 3 page for the card, disclosed the shared scenes and retained both interior renders.
review.location: Matched Emaar’s named Palmiera 3 point and the regional map published alongside it. Verified the launch sheet’s travel figures and disclosed its two Downtown estimates. E44 extension and future metro lines are qualified.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all four physical pages, including the cover. Retained the three complete Palmiera 3 drawings and verified all imperial totals within 0.01 sq ft. All three drawings mark the pool as owner-provided.
